responsibility: Defines the new-solver fulfillment engine used by trait selection code to accumulate predicate obligations, repeatedly evaluate and requeue them, preserve overflowed obligations, invoke proof-tree inspection hooks, and translate solver outcomes into `TraitEngine` errors and diagnostics-oriented obligation causes.
same_name_distinction: This `fulfill.rs` implements fulfillment for the new trait solver, using the solver’s goal evaluation, proof-tree inspection, and explicit overflow preservation, whereas `traits/fulfill.rs` is the old obligation-forest-based fulfillment engine tied to legacy selection/projection.
